intent: Yellow-green phosphor on a dark olive field. Chosen anchors, not a measured CRT state; the B photograph stays as historical evidence only.

derivation.method: Five chosen anchors. Every other UI shade mixes the foreground over the background per sRGB channel at the stated weight and rounds; --emphasized repeats the foreground, --code-foreground is the syntax foreground and --error is a dim phosphor level that keeps 4.5:1 on the background.
derivation.syntaxPolicy: Code is an explicit multicolour fluorescent exception: independently selected saturated accents, not shades of the phosphor UI.

effects.textGlow: 0 0 2px currentColor, 0 0 8px of the foreground at 45% (color-mix of --foreground)
effects.overlay: Fixed, pointer-events: none, behind the content (z-index -1): a 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) line every 3px plus a radial vignette to rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) at the edges. It darkens the field only, never text.
effects.motion: None. No animation, flicker, moving lines or curvature.

contrast.note: Calculated sRGB contrast of flat colours, before glow and overlay; not measured monitor brightness.
